description: Liquidation price calculator for a leveraged perpetual-futures position (isolated margin, linear contracts): liquidation price, how far the price can move before it, margin and notional, and the funding cost per day at a funding rate you give. Arithmetic, not advice. US$0.002 per call; 3 free calls a day.

funding_hourly.description: Optional hourly funding rate, e.g. 0.0000125, for the daily funding cost.

title: Liquidation price calculator
